about.title: About NZELA-SERVICE
about.subtitle: The platform connecting clients with technical service providers in Cameroon.
about.intro: NZELA-SERVICE is a digital platform designed to simplify finding and booking qualified technical service providers: electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, painters, carpenters and many other trades. Our goal is simple: to help everyone quickly find an available, trustworthy professional, wherever they are in Cameroon.
about.missionText: We want to make access to everyday technical services as easy as an online booking: search by trade and city, real-time availability, booking directly from the provider's profile, and secure payment via Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money or Wave.
about.how1: The client describes their need and chooses a provider based on their specialty, city and reviews.
about.how2: They book a slot directly in the provider's calendar.
about.how3: The provider talks with the client, prices the intervention and confirms the appointment.
about.how4: Once the intervention is complete, the client pays online and can rate the provider.
about.value1: Trust: verified profiles and genuine reviews left by real clients.
about.value2: Simplicity: a booking journey designed to keep things essential.
about.value3: Transparency: a price agreed before the intervention, no surprises.
about.value4: Proximity: local providers, available near you.
about.joinText: Are you a technical professional looking to grow your client base? Create your provider profile in a few minutes and start receiving requests.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know to use NZELA-SERVICE.
faq.q1: How do I book a provider?
faq.a1: Search for a trade or service from the home page, choose a provider based on their city, reviews and availability, then select a slot directly in their calendar. You then describe your need and confirm the request.
faq.a2: The provider contacts you to agree on the price of the intervention. Once this amount is confirmed and the intervention is underway, payment is made online via Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money or Wave.
faq.a3: NZELA-SERVICE accepts Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money and Wave. Other payment methods may be added progressively.
faq.q4: How do I become a provider on the platform?
faq.a4: Click "Become a provider", create your account specifying your trade, city and contact details. Your profile then becomes visible in search results matching your specialty.
faq.q5: Does the platform take a commission?
faq.a5: Yes, a 5% commission is charged on the amount of each intervention paid through the platform. It covers the service's operating costs (hosting, secure payment, support).
faq.q6: What happens if I need to cancel an appointment?
faq.a6: You can talk directly with the provider or client involved to reschedule the intervention. We recommend giving as much notice as possible in case of an unexpected change.
faq.a7: Each provider states their trade, skills and certifications when signing up. Newly added certifications are marked "pending verification" until validated.
faq.a8: For any question not covered here, you can write to us via the Contact section in the footer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: July 2026
privacy.notice: This policy describes, in general terms, how NZELA-SERVICE collects, uses and protects its users' personal data, in line with the personal data protection principles applicable in Cameroon (notably law n° 2010/012 of 21 December 2010 on cybersecurity and cybercrime) as well as international best practices. This document is informational and will be revised as the service and applicable regulations evolve.
privacy.s1Text: Personal data collected via NZELA-SERVICE is processed by the platform operator, as part of connecting clients with technical service providers.
privacy.s2Text: We collect the data you provide directly when creating your account and using the platform:
privacy.s2B1: Identification data: last name, first name, email address, phone number.
privacy.s2B2: Provider profile data: trade, city, skills, declared certifications.
privacy.s2B3: Intervention-related data: intervention address, dates, time slots, agreed amounts.
privacy.s2B4: Payment data: transactions made via Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money or Wave (NZELA-SERVICE does not store the credentials or secret codes of these services).
privacy.s2B5: Technical data: device type, browser, IP address, connection logs.
privacy.s3B1: Create and manage your user account (client or provider).
privacy.s3B2: Connect clients and providers and facilitate booking.
privacy.s3B3: Process payments related to completed interventions.
privacy.s3B4: Ensure support, security and fraud prevention on the platform.
privacy.s3B5: Keep you informed about the progress of your bookings and interventions.
privacy.s3B6: Improve the quality and usability of the service.
privacy.s4Text: The processing of your data is based on the performance of the contract binding you to NZELA-SERVICE when you create an account, on your consent where required (for example for certain communications), and on the platform's legitimate interest in ensuring its proper operation and security.
privacy.s5Text: Your data is only shared with third parties strictly necessary for the service to operate:
privacy.s5B1: The providers or clients involved in a booking (name, contact details, intervention address).
privacy.s5B2: Mobile payment operators (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Wave) for processing transactions.
privacy.s5B3: The technical providers who host and secure the platform.
privacy.s5Footer: NZELA-SERVICE does not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.s6Text: Your data is retained for the duration of your registration on the platform, then archived or deleted within a reasonable period after your account is closed, unless a longer legal retention obligation applies (notably for accounting or tax purposes).
privacy.s7Text: In accordance with personal data protection principles, you have the following rights over your data:
privacy.s7B1: Right of access to your personal data.
privacy.s7B2: Right to rectify inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.s7B3: Right to erasure of your data, subject to legal retention obligations.
privacy.s7B4: Right to object to certain processing, notably for marketing purposes.
privacy.s7B5: Right to data portability, where technically possible.
privacy.s7Footer: To exercise these rights, you can contact us via the Contact section in the footer.
privacy.s8Text: NZELA-SERVICE implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or disclosure.
privacy.s9Text: The platform may use cookies or similar technologies to ensure the service runs properly, remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.
privacy.s10Text: This privacy policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in the service or applicable regulations. The last update date is shown at the top of this page.
privacy.s11Text: For any question regarding this policy or the processing of your personal data, you can contact us via the Contact section in the footer.
